subject.description: The file path, or path:line, the finding is about.

observation.description: WHAT IS IN THE CODE, stated so a reader can check it against the file without trusting anything else here. No cause, no blame, no fix.

root_cause_hypothesis.description: WHY the observation is thought to be a defect. This is a claim, not a fact, and is held separately from the observation for exactly that reason.

alternative_explanations.description: At least one other reading of the same observation. Required because a hunter that can only see its own explanation has not looked; empty here means the stage did not do the work.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state that would produce the wrong behaviour, if any can be named yet.

confidence.description: The model's opinion of its own output. RECORDED FOR CALIBRATION AND NEVER USED IN GRADING -- see lenses/code_defects/grade.py.

notes.description: Anything about the hunt itself: what was not looked at, what could not be read.
